description: This file defines a PHP class `HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal` that extends a WebDAV server implementation to handle vCal calendar data over WebDAV protocol. It includes methods for serving WebDAV requests, handling GET and PUT methods for vCal data, session management, and access control, focusing on calendar publishing and synchronization within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM context.

classes.name: HTTP_WebDAV_Server_vCal
classes.description: A PHP class extending WebDAV server to provide calendar data (vCal) over WebDAV, with focus on SugarCRM/SuiteCRM integration for sharing calendar availability.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance, creating bean objects for calendar (`vCals`) and user (`Users`).

methods.name: ServeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming WebDAV requests, managing authentication, URL parsing, and setting up context for calendar access.

methods.name: check_auth
methods.description: Authenticates client requests based on sessions or publish keys, supports Basic auth with login fallback.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the server can handle GET requests.

methods.name: http_GET
methods.description: Handles GET requests to serve calendar free/busy data in vCal format if `vcal_type` is 'vfb'.

methods.name: http_PUT
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to upload or update vCal data for calendar sharing, with content type validation and authorization checks.

methods.name: PUT
methods.description: Placeholder for handling additional PUT logic, currently empty.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Handles lock requests, enforced with a default timeout.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles unlock requests, always returning success.

methods.name: checkLock
methods.description: Checks for existing locks on resources; currently always returns false indicating no lock.
